deviations.what: t13 cleanup node: in production its run cancels need either the operator's Access cookie granted to the node (against boundary c13's spirit) or a bounded policy widening that admits the runner/cleanup principal to POST /runs/{id}/cancel with a reason — a decision for the owner before the node is deployed; until then the cleanup of the 26 parked #307 runs and 8 branches stays an operator turn
deviations.reason: principalPolicy makes POST /v1alpha1/runs/{id}/cancel a namespace-administrator route and agentMayWrite (internal/api/actorbearer.go) does not admit agent bearers to it; admitting an agent principal to cancel runs is a policy decision the plan did not make, so t13 left the policy untouched and exposed NODES_API_TOKEN / NODES_API_COOKIE seams instead; also refs from runs that predate the work_item column are listed as unattributed and never deleted, so the first live run reports rather than removes the 8 existing review-fix/pr307-* branches
